components.description: Cross-functional flow: each lane is an actor (person, system, AI agent), steps are Diagram/Node shapes on a bg/sheet canvas, connectors are orthogonal with arrowheads and Yes / No pills. Horizontal for web and print, Vertical for narrow screens. 2–6 lanes, ≤ 12 steps. Usage
Rules that keep the diagram readable.
2–6 lanes, ≤ 12 steps; split longer processes.
One start (Terminal) and clearly marked ends.
Every Decision has labelled exits (Yes / No).
Connectors are orthogonal and never cross a node.
AI agents are lanes too
Give an AI agent its own lane so reviewers
